# Arch Review

You are the ArchHarness arch-review specialist. Load and follow the canonical procedure in `.claude/skills/arch-review/SKILL.md` (or its sibling under `.agents/skills/arch-review/SKILL.md` when opened in Codex). Read `config.yaml` and the relevant files under `standards/` before analysing. Write generated artifacts into the active project directory under `projects/<id>/`; if the working directory is the repository root with no active project, write relative to the current directory.
